programs.title: Beautiful photo, wonderful life
programs.desc: Photojournalist Amanda Mustard returns to her childhood home in Pennsylvania.She wants to investigate sexual abuse crimes committed by her own grandfather.

programs.title: Hail Mary
programs.desc: Popular writer Maria (Laura Weissmahr) has recently become a mother.Her days are filled with caring for her son and visiting doctors.There is virtually no time left to create.To make matters worse, the husband keeps postponing the promised paternity leave and ignores the difficulties his wife is facing.At this time, Barcelona is shaken by information about the crime committed by a young French woman who drowned her 10-month-old twins in the bathtub.Maria follows this case with increasing attention, which slowly becomes her obsession.

programs.title: Nonostante
programs.desc: A certain man (Valerio Mastandrea) has been in the hospital for a long time, where he leads a quiet life, free from worries and responsibilities.Isolated from the world, he feels safe and considers this place the best for himself.While other patients feel limited, the hospital offers everything he needs.The situation changes when a new patient appears on the ward.She is full of anger, does not agree to the rules of the facility and wants to leave it as soon as possible so that she can truly live.Over time, a man decides to open up to what is foreign to him.Valerio Mastandrea on both sides of the camera.

programs.title: Unexpected Grace
programs.desc: Teenage Grace (Erica Tremblay) discovers a note written by a student looking for new friends.The girl decides to write back, which triggers a chain of events that change other people's lives.

programs.title: A Carpenter Christmas Romance
programs.desc: Writer Andrea returns to her family farm in Wildwood just before the holidays.She begins an affair with her ex-boyfriend Seth, who was employed in the crew renovating the town after the recent fire.

programs.title: Detective Monk: One last thing
programs.desc: Brilliant detective Adrian Monk (Tony Shalhoub) is going through difficult times.The contract to publish his autobiography was canceled, and the coronavirus pandemic intensified his fears and phobias.All this makes the master of deduction start thinking about ending his life and joining his beloved Truda.He is jolted out of his torpor by the tragedy that befalls his stepdaughter Molly (Caitlin McGee).The girl is getting ready to marry journalist Griffin Briggs (Austin Scott).However, her fiancé dies while bungee jumping.Molly is convinced that it was not an accident, but a carefully planned murder.The trail leads to the influential billionaire Rick Eden (James Purefoy).Retired Captain Stottlemeyer (Ted Levine) now works for the rich man as his security chief.Monk is assisted in the investigation by former assistant and now real estate agent Natalie Teeger (Traylor Howard) and Randy Disher (Jason Gray-Stanford), now the New Jersey police commissioner.Continuation of the cult series.

programs.title: Veep 6
programs.desc: Selina Meyer (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) briefly enjoyed the presidency.After losing, the ambitious politician must come to terms with the fact that the leader of the free world and president of the United States is this time not her, but Laura Montez (Andrea Savage).After moving out of the White House, Meyer tries to find his way in his new situation.The sixth installment of the HBO comedy series revealing the behind-the-scenes of American politics.The originator of the series is Oscar nominee Armando Iannucci (The Thick of It, Looped), and the main roles include Golden Globe winner Julia Louis-Dreyfus (The Seinfeld Chronicles), Emmy winner Tony Hale (Hot Goods), Anna Chlumsky (My Girl), Reid Scott (My Guys) and Matt Walsh (The Water Breaks).The production has received numerous awards, including:twelve Emmy statuettes, as well as seven Golden Globe nominations.

programs.title: Veep 6
programs.desc: Selina Meyer (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) briefly enjoyed the presidency.After losing, the ambitious politician must come to terms with the fact that the leader of the free world and president of the United States is this time not her, but Laura Montez (Andrea Savage).After moving out of the White House, Meyer tries to find his way in his new situation.The sixth installment of the HBO comedy series revealing the behind-the-scenes of American politics.The originator of the series is Oscar nominee Armando Iannucci (The Thick of It, Looped), and the main roles include Golden Globe winner Julia Louis-Dreyfus (The Seinfeld Chronicles), Emmy winner Tony Hale (Hot Goods), Anna Chlumsky (My Girl), Reid Scott (My Guys) and Matt Walsh (The Water Breaks).The production has received numerous awards, including:twelve Emmy statuettes, as well as seven Golden Globe nominations.

programs.title: Eine Million Minuten
programs.desc: Spouses Vera (Karoline Herfurth) and Wolf (Tom Schilling) Küper, parents of Nina (Pola Friedrichs) and Simon (Piet Levi Busch), have difficulty dividing their time between work and household duties.The bond that united them years ago is weakening.Wolf focuses on his professional career, and Vera, confined to her four walls, is fed up with loneliness and having to replace her children's fathers.The family's world is ruined by the daughter's disastrous medical diagnosis.Wolf recalls that the girl's greatest wish was to spend a million minutes solely on pleasure.The Küpers decide to make her dream come true.Together they set off on a lifelong journey that leads through exotic regions of the world.They get to know new places and foreign cultures, and decide what their future will look like.

programs.title: In short
programs.desc: The year 2019, on the threshold of the pandemic.Single woman Ellen (Laura Tonke) spends New Year's Eve with her friends.No one knows that she is having an affair with Sebastian (Ronald Zehrfeld), Eva's (Antje Traue) husband.Rolf (Nicholas Ofczarek) and Dina (Pegah Ferydoni) make a perfect couple, unlike Mareike (Annette Frier) and Adam (Trystan Pütter).Maya (Katia Fellin) wants children, Natalie (Jasmin Shakeri) cannot decide.Max (Henning Flüsloh) comes into Ellen's life and he would love her if she let him.Years pass.The woman attends various types of celebrations, birthday parties and casual social gatherings.He learns about events in his friends' lives.The sense of community unites and allows everyone to return to everyday life with positive energy.Remake of the Danish film "A Long Story Briefly".

programs.title: Jane Austen Wrecked My Life
programs.desc: Agathe, a shy employee of the Shakespeare \u0026 Co. bookstore.in Paris, dreams of romantic love like in a Jane Austen novel and success as a writer.An invitation to England gives her a chance to change her fate.

programs.title: The Last Showgirl
programs.desc: After thirty years, dancer Shelly Gardner (Pamela Anderson) ends her career.For decades, she performed in a strip revue in Las Vegas, which was inspired by French burlesque.The stage, costumes and music are her passion, for which she sacrificed her family life and relationship with her daughter, Hannah (Billie Lourd).She shared her knowledge and experience with beginner friends Marianne (Brenda Song) and Jodie (Kiernan Shipka).One day, however, producer Eddie (Dave Bautista) announces that the show has been canceled.A devastated Shelly must re-plan her future.A similar fate will befall her friend Annette (Jamie Lee Curtis), a dealer at an arcade.Golden Globe for Pamela Anderson.
